subject: Error with fitting type 4 interaction model with covariates

messages.author: 92737d96d07e78d4
messages.subject: Error with fitting type 4 interaction model with covariates
parts:
Dear all,

I am fitting a spatiotemporal interaction model with covariates assuming negative binomial likelihood.for 120 monthly count data from 518 blocks over 10 years . The INLA halted with the following error after 33 function evaluations. 

GitId: a9cbf350377487b3f57d7871d9decdcfd0a3c5af - Thu Oct 19 11:05:00 2023 +0300

   Error:12 Reason: The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge

   Message: Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE

   Line:1029 Function: GMRFLib_init_GMRF_approximation_store__intern


This was not an issue when I was running same code under r-inla version 2022-10-23. Currently I am using r-inla ver 23.10.19-1. I am unable to identify and debug the error.

I have attached herewith the r-code and the console error output (partial, as I could not capture the entire screen output) for your kind perusal and help.  

For your kind information, the error occurs in both windows as well as macos.

Thanks and regards,
S. Subramanian

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error with fitting type 4 interaction model with covariates
parts:
you may need to add 'diagonal' on this component since its singular

f(ID.area.month, model="generic0", Cmatrix=R_1_4, rankdef=r_def_1_4,
hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif)),
diagonal = 1e-4, constr=TRUE, extraconstr=list(A=A_constr_1_4,
e=rep(0,nrow(A_constr_1_4)))) +


its a large model with many constraints...

I'll try to run it here
